This notebook is for the analysis of the section 'Prevalence and Burden of Colibactin Mutagenesis'
It outlines the derivation of the summary statistics and comparisons for the prevalence, burden of SBS88 / ID18 mutations, and for the construction of Figure 2.B

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggh4x)
library(broom.mixed)
```

load in relevant data frames for this analysis :
```{r}
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')
crypt_signature_attributions <- read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
```

## a : summary statistics of exposures:
### i : summary statistics of prevalence
```{r}
# determine positive children
pos_patients=length(unique(crypt_signature_attributions[crypt_signature_attributions$patient_colibactin_pos==TRUE,]$patient))
all_patients=length(unique(crypt_signature_attributions$patient))
pos_biopsy=length(unique(crypt_signature_attributions[crypt_signature_attributions$biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE,]$biopsy)) 
proportion_patients_positive<-round((pos_patients/all_patients)*100,digits=0) 

## state the results
print(paste0('Total number of patients : n=',all_patients))  # n=85 patients
print(paste0('Patients positive : n=',pos_patients))  # n=37 patients
print(paste0('Proportion of patients positive : ',proportion_patients_positive,"%"))  # n=37 patients
print(paste0('Biopsies positive : n=',pos_biopsy)) # n=48 biopsies
```
### ii : compare prevalence of colibactin by cohort :
compare prevalence of colibactin positive between ibd and normal individuals:
```{r}
cohort_sum_table<-left_join(crypt_signature_attributions, crypt_metadata,by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%
  filter(!duplicated(patient))%>%
  group_by(cohort,patient_colibactin_pos)%>%
  summarise(patient = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = patient_colibactin_pos, values_from = patient, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cohort") %>%
  as.matrix()

## summarise by cohort :
n_normal_pos=cohort_sum_table['IBD','TRUE']
prop_normal_pos=round(cohort_sum_table['IBD','TRUE'] / rowSums(cohort_sum_table)['IBD']*100)
n_ibd_pos=cohort_sum_table['Normal','TRUE']
prop_ibd_pos=round(cohort_sum_table['Normal','TRUE'] / rowSums(cohort_sum_table)['Normal']*100)

## print the outputs
print(paste0('Normal patients positive : n=',n_normal_pos))  # n=14 patients
print(paste0('Proportion normal patients positive : ',prop_normal_pos, '%'))  # 45%
print(paste0('IBD patients positive : n=',n_ibd_pos))  # n=21 patients
print(paste0('Proportion IBD patients positive : n=',prop_ibd_pos,'%')) # n=39%
```

```{r}
## perform fishers test
fisher.test(cohort_sum_table)
```

Here we select only those individuals who had two biopsies
```{r}

donors_two_biopsies_df<-left_join(crypt_signature_attributions, crypt_metadata,by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%
  group_by(patient)%>%

print(paste0('Donors with two biopsies: ',length(unique(donors_two_biopsies_df$patient))))
```

```{r}
## donors with two biopsies who are positive in at least one crypt :
number_pos_donors_two_biopsies=donors_two_biopsies_df%>%
  filter(patient_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>%
  filter(!duplicated(patient))%>%nrow()
print(paste0('Donors with two biopsies: ',number_pos_donors_two_biopsies))
```

Provide a breakdown of positive biopsies by anatomical location
```{r}
## create a breakdown of positive biopsies by locaiton
donors_two_biopsies_df%>%
  filter(patient_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>%
  filter(!duplicated(biopsy))%>%
  select(patient, biopsy_colibactin_pos,location)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=location, values_from =biopsy_colibactin_pos)%>%
  mutate(summary=case_when(Sigmoid==TRUE & Ascending==TRUE ~'Both positive',
                       Sigmoid==TRUE & Ascending ==FALSE ~ 'Only sigmoid positive',
                       Sigmoid==FALSE & Ascending ==TRUE ~ 'Only ascending positive',
                       TRUE ~ 'Neither'))%>%
  group_by(summary)%>%
  summarise(n=length(summary))
```

### v: look at proportion of crypts that are positive in a given biopsy :
```{r}
crypts_biopsy_sum<-crypt_signature_attributions%>%
  filter(biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>%
  mutate(crypt_colibactin_pos=(SBS88>0 & ID18>0))%>%
  group_by(biopsy)%>%
  summarise(n_positive_crypts=sum(crypt_colibactin_pos),
            n_crypts=n())%>%
  mutate(prop_crypts_positive=n_positive_crypts / n_crypts)%>%
  summarise(median_prop_pos=median(prop_crypts_positive), # median proportion of crypts pos (100%)
            median_count=median(n_positive_crypts), # median number of positive crypts per biopsy
            n_biopsies_all_crypts_positive=sum(prop_crypts_positive==1), # number of biopsies with 100% of crypts positive
            n_biopsies=n(), # number of biopsies
            lqr=quantile(prop_crypts_positive,0.25))

print(paste0('Median number of positive crypts per biopsy: ',crypts_biopsy_sum$median_count, ' crypts'))
print(paste0('Median proportion of positive crypts per biopsy : ',crypts_biopsy_sum$median_prop_pos*100, '%'))
print(paste0('Number of biopsies with all crypts positive : ',crypts_biopsy_sum$n_biopsies_all_crypts_positive, ' biopsies'))
print(paste0('Total number of positive biopsies : ',crypts_biopsy_sum$n_biopsies, ' biopsies'))
print(paste0('Proportion of biopsies with all crypts positive : ', round((crypts_biopsy_sum$n_biopsies_all_crypts_positive / crypts_biopsy_sum$n_biopsies)*100,0) , '%'))
```

## b : mutation burden of colibactin
### i : calcualte summary metrics
```{r}
# summary for SBS88
min_sbs88_burden=min(crypt_signature_attributions[crypt_signature_attributions$biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE & crypt_signature_attributions$SBS88>0,]$SBS88,na.rm=T)
max_sbs88_burden=max(crypt_signature_attributions[crypt_signature_attributions$biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE & crypt_signature_attributions$SBS88>0,]$SBS88,na.rm=T)

# summary for ID18
min_id18_burden=min(crypt_signature_attributions[crypt_signature_attributions$biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE & crypt_signature_attributions$ID18>0,]$ID18,na.rm=T)
max_id18_burden=max(crypt_signature_attributions[crypt_signature_attributions$biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE & crypt_signature_attributions$ID18>0,]$ID18,na.rm=T)

print(paste0('Min SBS88 burden:', min_sbs88_burden,' mutations'))
print(paste0('Max SBS88 burden:', max_sbs88_burden,' mutations'))

print(paste0('Min ID18 burden:', min_id18_burden,' mutations'))
print(paste0('Max ID18 burdne:', max_id18_burden,' mutations'))
```

### ii : perform comparisons by biopsy location :
```{r}
# filter for location :
location_df <- left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions,by=c('biopsy','patient'))%>%
  mutate(SBS88=SBS88/sensitivitySBS,ID18=ID18/sensitivityID)%>%
  filter(SBS88>0 & ID18>0& biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>% # subset positive crypts
  select(patient, crypt,site,SBS88,ID18)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c('SBS88','ID18'),values_to='count','names_to'='signature')
sigs <- c("SBS88", "ID18")

# Function to fit model comparing left to right colon and extract stats :
fit_location_model <- function(sig, data) {
  model <- lmer(count ~ site + (1 | patient), data = filter(data, signature == sig))
  tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%   # site comparison term
    mutate(
      signature = sig, estimate = round(estimate, 0), 
      low_ci = round(estimate - 1.96 * std.error, 0), 
      upp_ci = round(estimate + 1.96 * std.error, 0), p.value = round(p.value, 10)) %>%
    select(signature, estimate, low_ci, upp_ci, p.value)
}

# Run models
location_results <- map_dfr(sigs, fit_location_model, data = location_df)
location_results %>%
  mutate(text = paste0(signature, ": ", abs(estimate), " [", abs(upp_ci), ", ", abs(low_ci), "] P=", p.value,'\n')) %>%
  pull(text) %>%
  walk(cat)
```
### iii : perform comparisons by IBD and normal individuals :
```{r}
# filter for location :
ibd_normal_df <- left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions,by=c('biopsy','patient'))%>%
  mutate(SBS88=SBS88/sensitivitySBS,ID18=ID18/sensitivityID)%>%
  filter(SBS88>0 & ID18>0& biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>% # subset positive crypts
  select(patient, crypt,site,cohort,SBS88,ID18)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c('SBS88','ID18'),values_to='count','names_to'='signature')
sigs <- c("SBS88", "ID18")

# Function to fit model and extract stats
fit_cohort_model <- function(sig, data) {
  model <- lmer(count ~ site +cohort+ (1 | patient), data = filter(data, signature == sig))
  tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(term == "cohortNormal") %>%   # site comparison term
    mutate(
      signature = sig, estimate = round(estimate, 0), 
      low_ci = round(estimate - 1.96 * std.error, 0), 
      upp_ci = round(estimate + 1.96 * std.error, 0), p.value = round(p.value, 3)) %>%
    select(signature, estimate, low_ci, upp_ci, p.value)
}

# Run models
ibd_normal_results <- map_dfr(sigs, fit_cohort_model, data = ibd_normal_df)
ibd_normal_results %>%
  mutate(text = paste0(signature, ": ", (estimate), " [", (upp_ci), ", ", (low_ci), "] P=", p.value,'\n')) %>%
  pull(text) %>%
  walk(cat)
```

### iv : compare children and adults :
For this analysis, we will compare SBS88 / ID18 burdens from our study and Lee-six et al. Nature. 2019
```{r}
## Lee Six et al Nature 2019 attributions : Taken from Supplementary Table of paper
adult_crypt_metadata <- read.csv('..//Data/Lee_Six_Nature_2019/41586_2019_1672_MOESM4_ESM.csv')
adult_crypt_attributions <- read.table('../Data/Lee_Six_Nature_2019/41586_2019_1672_MOESM5_ESM.txt',sep='\t',header=T)

adult_crypt_attributions <- left_join(adult_crypt_attributions,adult_crypt_metadata,by=c('patient'='patient_label_in_files','age','sex'))%>%
  
  # subset for just adults :
  filter(age>18)%>%

  # format variables to facilitate analyses :
  mutate(location=case_when(str_detect(site, 'Left') ~ 'Left',
                            TRUE~'Right'),
         cohort='Adult',
         colibactin_present=ifelse((SBSA>100 | SBSA/sbstotal>0.05) & (IDA>5 | IDA/idtotal>0.05),TRUE,FALSE))%>% # use criteria from Lee Six paper 
  
  # subset for just colibactin positive crypts
  filter(colibactin_present==TRUE)%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,crypt,age,location,cohort,SBSA,IDA)
colnames(adult_crypt_attributions)<-c('patient','crypt','age','site','cohort','SBS88','ID18')
```

reformat children's crypts burdens for analysis 
```{r}
## derive summaries per donor
children_crypt_attributions<-left_join(crypt_metadata,crypt_signature_attributions,by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%

  # subset just positive crypts
  filter(SBS88>0 & ID18>0& biopsy_colibactin_pos==TRUE)%>% # subset positive crypts
  mutate(cohort='Child')%>%
  select(patient,crypt,age,site,cohort,SBS88,ID18)

colnames(children_crypt_attributions)<-c('patient','crypt','age','site','cohort','SBS88','ID18')
```

combine to construct a master datafame for analysis and for plotting
```{r}
## construct a combined dataframe to facilitate plotting :
compare_children_adult_df<-rbind(children_crypt_attributions,adult_crypt_attributions)%>%
  
  # convert to long format to facilitate plotting
  pivot_longer(cols=c('SBS88','ID18'),values_to='count',names_to='signature')%>%
  
  # select only cases with positive burdens for SBS88 / ID18 
  filter(count>0)%>%
  
  # stipulate factor levels
  mutate(site=factor(site,levels=c('Left','Right')),
         cohort=factor(cohort, levels=c('Child','Adult')),
         signature=factor(signature,levels=c('SBS88','ID18')))
```

### v. compare between paediatric crypts and normal adult crypts:
```{r}
## run linear mixed effects for children versus adult with stratification by site
compare_children_adult=compare_children_adult_df %>%
  group_by(site, signature) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- lmer(count ~ cohort + (1 | patient), data = .x)
    broom.mixed::tidy(model)})%>%
  filter(effect=='fixed' & term!='(Intercept)')

# obtain model estimates
estimate=round(compare_children_adult$estimate,digits=0)
upper_ci=round(compare_children_adult$estimate+1.96*compare_children_adult$std.error,digits=0)
lower_ci=round(compare_children_adult$estimate-1.96*compare_children_adult$std.error,digits=0)
compare_children_adult$sum=paste0(estimate,' [',lower_ci,',',upper_ci,']')
compare_children_adult$p.value=round(compare_children_adult$p.value,digits=3)
compare_children_adult$comparison='children adult'


compare_children_adult<-compare_children_adult%>%
  select(signature,site, comparison,sum,p.value)%>%
  arrange(signature)

# print the outputs from model estimates
print(compare_children_adult)
```

### viii : compare prevalence between lee_six and our dataset
```{r}
## lee_six attributions :
adult_crypt_metadata <- read.csv('..//Data/Lee_Six_Nature_2019/41586_2019_1672_MOESM4_ESM.csv')
adult_crypt_attributions <- read.table('../Data/Lee_Six_Nature_2019/41586_2019_1672_MOESM5_ESM.txt',sep='\t',header=T)%>%

  # join with metadata
  left_join(adult_crypt_metadata,by=c('patient'='patient_label_in_files','age','sex'))%>%
  
  # filter for adults
  filter(age>18)%>%
  
  # annotate for locationa and colibactin status
  mutate(location=case_when(str_detect(site, 'Left') ~ 'Left',
                            TRUE~'Right'),
         colibactin_present=ifelse((SBSA>100 | SBSA/sbstotal>0.05) & (IDA>5 | IDA/idtotal>0.05),TRUE,FALSE))%>%
  dplyr::select(patient,crypt,site,age,colibactin_present,bowel_cancer_diagnosis,SBSA,IDA)

# summary table :
adult_crypt_prevalence<-adult_crypt_attributions%>%
  group_by(patient)%>%
  summarise(site=first(site), age=min(age), bowel_cancer_diagnosis=first(bowel_cancer_diagnosis),
            patient_colibactin_pos=sum(colibactin_present,na.rm=T)>1)%>%
  group_by(patient_colibactin_pos)%>%
  summarise(adult=n())%>%
  column_to_rownames(var='patient_colibactin_pos')

# print outputs
adult_prev=round(adult_crypt_prevalence['TRUE',] / sum(adult_crypt_prevalence)*100,digits=0)
print(paste0('Colibactin prevalence in adults :', adult_prev,'%' ))
```

```{r}
# create summary table for children:
childre_prevalence<-left_join(crypt_signature_attributions, crypt_metadata,by=c('patient','biopsy'))%>%
  filter(!duplicated(patient))%>%
  group_by(patient_colibactin_pos)%>%
  summarise(children = n(), .groups = "drop")%>%
  column_to_rownames(var='patient_colibactin_pos')

# perform fisher's test :
fisher.test(t(cbind(adult_crypt_prevalence,childre_prevalence))) #p-value=0.333
  
```

##c : Figure 2.C : Boxplot for each individual biopsy in children's cohort
create an aggregate dataframe for plotting 
```{r}
## for comparison between children's locations, format the previous comparisons betwen locations:
children_site_compare<-location_results
children_site_compare$site='Both'
children_site_compare$comparison='children children'
children_site_compare$signature=str_remove(children_site_compare$signature,'\\s')

children_site_compare<-children_site_compare%>%
  select(signature,site, comparison, p.value)

# createa a combined dataframe
compare_p_values_df<-rbind(compare_children_adult,children_site_compare)%>%
  group_by(signature) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  mutate(label=case_when(p.value<0.001~'P < 0.001',
                         TRUE~paste0('P = ',round(p.value,digits=3))),
         comparison=factor(comparison,levels=c('children children','children adult')))%>%
  arrange(signature, site, comparison)

```


## d : Figure 2.D : Boxplot for Cohort Summary
```{r}
## label_df for plotting p-values :
label_df=compare_p_values_df
label_df$y=c(550,500,500,3800,3500,3500)
label_df$x=c(2,1.5,3.5,2,1.5,3.5)
label_df$signature=factor(label_df$signature, levels=c('SBS88','ID18'))

# create df for plotting brakcets :
brackets_df <- data.frame(
  signature = compare_p_values_df$signature,
  xstart    = c(1, 1,3,1,1,3),        # starting x for bracket
  xend      = c(3, 2,4,3,2,4),        # ending x for bracket
  y         = c(550,500,500,3800,3500,3500)   # height of the bracket
)
brackets_df$signature=factor(brackets_df$signature, levels=c('SBS88','ID18'))

## stipulate factor order for plotting :
compare_children_adult_df$group=paste(compare_children_adult_df$cohort, compare_children_adult_df$site,sep=' ')
compare_children_adult_df$group=factor(compare_children_adult_df$group, 
                                       levels=c("Child Left", "Adult Left","Child Right","Adult Right"))
## initialise plot :
svg('~/cohort_summary.svg',width=12,height=10,bg='transparent')

ggplot(compare_children_adult_df, aes(x = group, y = count, fill = group)) +
  
  # construct boxplot :
  geom_boxplot(size = 0.7,outlier=F) +
  
  # fcet by signature :
  facet_grid(signature~ ., scales = "free", space = "free_x", switch='y',
             label=labeller(signature=as_labeller(c(SBS88='SBS88 Mutation Burden',  ID18='ID18 Mutation Burden')))) +
   facetted_pos_scales(y = list(signature == "SBS88" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4000)), TRUE ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,600)))) +
  
  # stipulate colour scheme
  scale_fill_manual(values =c('thistle1', 'orchid4','thistle1', 'orchid4')) +
  
  # add in pvalues :
  geom_text(data = label_df, aes(x = x, y = y *1.05, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE, fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  # add in brakces and pvalues :
  geom_segment(data = brackets_df, aes(x = xstart, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets_df, aes(x = xstart, xend = xstart, y = y, yend = 0.97*y),  inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets_df,  aes(x = xend, xend = xend, y = y, yend = 0.97*y), inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.8) +
  
  
  
  # stipulate x axis :
  scale_x_discrete(breaks=c("Child Left", "Adult Left","Child Right","Adult Right"),
                   labels=c('Childhood Colon\nLeft Side', 'Adult Colon\nLeft Side',
                            'Childhood Colon\nRight Side','Adult Colon\nRight Side'))+
  
  # formate theme 
  labs(fill = 'crypt Type') +
  
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14,face='bold'),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = 'none',
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement='outside',
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
  )
dev.off()
```
